title: fix(fields): an Enter that picks an input-method candidate no longer moves the grid field, commits a date or jumps the picker page; one isImeKey
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVwX4pUdM1qvNLSqRZNSvv3)_

Fixes #35996

Clause-②: yes (widening): the `@object-ui/components` entry gains one value export, `isImeKey(e: { nativeEvent: KeyboardEvent; keyCode?: number }): boolean`. Measured on the built declarations: the components `dist/index.d.ts` gains exactly `export { isImeKey } from './lib/ime-key.js';` plus the new `lib/ime-key.d.ts`. The `@object-ui/fields` entry declarations are byte-identical to main (`index.d.ts` unchanged; 120 of 121 emitted `.d.ts` identical, and the one that differs is the internal `widgets/imeKey.d.ts`, which no export path and no other `.d.ts` reaches). Nothing is removed or narrowed.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill teaches the input-method key guard (zero hits for `isImeKey` or `isComposing` under `skills/`), and field behaviour outside a composition is unchanged

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgW85kwjGaz7HqsmEuv

## 维护者速读

- 用中文、日文、韩文输入法打字时，按回车选词不再误触发：表单里的明细表格不再跳到下一行或多加一行，日期框不再把打了一半的日期当成输入提交，选择记录弹窗的页码框不再跳页、清空。
- 这是输入法回车问题的收尾，前一张卡修了标签、查找、人员三个控件，这次补上剩下三个，并把判断「这个键归输入法」的规则合成一份，以后改一处就全生效。
- 出错的话最多是这三处在输入法下按回车没反应；不碰数据和保存逻辑，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

**Three guards** (`@object-ui/fields`), each the first line of the handler:

- `GridField` cell `onKeyDown` (`onCellKeyDown`): a key the input method owns no longer moves to the next line or appends one on the last line. The same guard covers this handler's ArrowUp and ArrowDown, which an input method uses to move through its candidates. The guard sits on line 1 of `onCellKeyDown`, which open PR #36039 (S5) leaves unchanged, so it applies the same way to S5's extra callers of the handler.
- `DatePickerField` / `DateTimePickerField`: the candidate-picking Enter no longer commits the half-typed text. Since #36054 (S4) both the field face and the in-cell panel draw the text box through one `textBox` helper, so the guard is on that single Enter handler and covers both.
- `RecordPickerDialog` page-jump box (`handlePageJump`): the candidate-picking Enter no longer jumps or clears the box.

**One predicate.** `isImeKey` is defined once, in `ui/packages/components/src/lib/ime-key.ts`, and exported from the `@object-ui/components` entry. The grid's `dataTableCellSelection.ts` and `fields/src/widgets/imeKey.ts` now only re-export it. The fields module stays a one-line re-export rather than being deleted because #36039 imports `./imeKey.js`. Each of the two modules keeps its local import path, and the repository has one function body. A test asserts that the function fields uses is the same object the components entry exports.

Phase-1 reproduction in real Chromium (CDP `Input.imeSetComposition`, then Enter with keyCode 229, then `Input.insertText`), all three on main 615d9954: the grid moved 0-0 to 1-0 and the committed text landed in row 1, and on the last row it appended a line. The date box committed "2026-0" and showed "Not saved". The picker jumped from page 1 to 2 and cleared the box. A plain Enter worked as designed in each.

**Files to read first (by risk):**

1. `ui/packages/components/src/index.ts`: the one new entry export (the Clause-② surface).
2. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx`, the `onCellKeyDown` hunk: the guard also stops the arrows during a composition.
3. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/imeKey.ts`: now a re-export, not a second definition.

**Two-minute check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields exec vitest run --root ../.. --maxWorkers=2 packages/fields/src/widgets/imeComposition-35996.test.tsx` should report 9 passed.

## Tests

`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/imeComposition-35996.test.tsx` (9 tests). Each widget is driven through both real browser sequences: Chromium/Firefox (compositionstart, keydown Enter with `isComposing: true` and keyCode 229, compositionend) and Safari (compositionstart, compositionend, then the 229 Enter). Each case ends with a plain Enter as the control check, so a guard that swallowed every Enter would fail. There is also one identity test for the single predicate. The existing `imeComposition-35797.test.tsx` predicate cases now run against the shared definition through the re-export.

## Acceptance notes

- Overlap with #36039 (S5), rechecked at the new head: still one trivial textual conflict in `GridField.tsx`'s import block. Both sides add `import { isImeKey } from './imeKey.js';` after the `fieldHelpText` import, and git merges that line as common. The conflict is only S5's extra `gridCellPanels.js` import line; keep it. Nothing in `onCellKeyDown` conflicts.
- #36054 (S4) has landed and is merged in. The one conflict, in `date-picker/DatePickerField.tsx`, was resolved by taking S4's `textBox` and putting the guard on its Enter handler. `data-table.tsx` needed nothing: it still imports `isImeKey` from `dataTableCellSelection`, and after the merge the repository has exactly one `keyCode === 229` body (`git grep` over non-test `ui/packages/*/src`).
- `RecordPickerDialog`'s `handleTableKeyDown` gets no guard: it listens on table rows, which are not editable, so no composition reaches it.

## Verification

Every reading below was taken at head `e19af2a8`, which is `b0724f52` merged with main `7dd1a2f6` (including #36054).

<details><summary>Package tests and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields exec vitest run --root ../.. --maxWorkers=2 packages/fields/` exited 0: Test Files 318 passed, 1 skipped (319); Tests 4794 passed, 7 skipped (4801).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components exec vitest run --root ../.. --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/` exited 0: Test Files 502 passed, 1 skipped (503); Tests 4822 passed, 24 skipped (4846).
- The 35996 and 35797 pins together: 19/19 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` exited 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` exited 0; it runs `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so the new test is type-checked too.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: one run per guard, each failing, each restored</summary>

Each ablation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which wraps the run under the verify lock. The test subjects resolve to fields `src/` through relative imports, so no `dist/` rebuild was needed.

- GridField `if (isImeKey(e)) return;` replaced with a comment: 4 failed, 5 passed (all four GridField cases). The first attempt queued behind another session's run and timed out (exit 99, NOT MEASURED). The rerun is the reading above.
- DatePickerField guard, taken again at `e19af2a8` on S4's `textBox` handler: 2 failed, 7 passed. Restore proven by the tool's own check (blob equals HEAD 90074f05, `git diff HEAD` empty) and by a separate hash comparison.
- RecordPickerDialog `|| isImeKey(e)`: 2 failed, 7 passed. The first attempt was refused by the tool before any test ran (its replacement text already occurred in the file), so it was a no-op. The rerun used a unique replacement.
- The GridField and RecordPickerDialog readings were taken at `b0724f52`. The merge does not touch either file: its diff against `b0724f52` is empty for both. Restore proven after each run: `git diff HEAD -- FILE` is empty, and the HEAD blob hash equals the on-disk hash (GridField ef12bb6b, RecordPickerDialog bd58ecdc).

</details>

<details><summary>Declarations: main vs this head</summary>

Both builds used `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components --filter @object-ui/fields build`. The main build came from main `7dd1a2f6`'s sources for both packages, with the new file moved aside; HEAD was then restored, proven by an empty `git diff HEAD` and by blob hashes, and rebuilt.

- components: `index.d.ts` gains `export { isImeKey } from './lib/ime-key.js';`, `lib/ime-key.d.ts` is new, and `renderers/complex/dataTableCellSelection.d.ts` now re-exports instead of declaring. Nothing else differs.
- fields: `index.d.ts` is byte-identical (`cmp`). Of the 121 emitted `.d.ts`, exactly one differs: `widgets/imeKey.d.ts`, which now reads `export { isImeKey } from '@object-ui/components';` in place of its own `declare function`. It is not reachable from `exports` (`.` only) or from any other `.d.ts`, so the published entry surface is unchanged, but the `dist/` tree is not byte-identical.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 38 commands, and all 38 exited 0. Reconciliation: `--ran` reports "38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 38 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". `test:repo` was not run locally; it belongs to CI.

</details>
